The audit report generation failed because the Word document summary omitted the required 'approval missing' compliance signal.
The test_word_summary_content in /tests/test_outputs.py failed with an AssertionError because 'approval missing' was not found in the generated OUTPUT_DOCX. While the script successfully identified 'break deficit' and produced a document, the compliance brief text failed to include all mandatory violation categories. Avoid omitting specific policy flags in the final narrative; ensure the logic captures both short breaks and missing overtime approvals as required by the audit rules.
